about: The secreta of the formulary “Saint Matthew, Apostle and Evangelist” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the prayers of the blessed Apostle and Evangelist Matthew, we beseech You, O Lord, recommend to You the offering made by Your Church, which is taught by his glorious preaching. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,
